summary: SLM Student Loan Trust 2005-5 furnished an 8-K reporting that Navient Solutions, LLC, as administrator, delivered a preliminary remarketing memorandum to remarketing agents on October 14, 2026, covering up to $211,500,769.95 of Class A-5 Reset Rate Notes originally issued June 29, 2005. The notes are offered at 100% of principal, pay SOFR plus a spread, reset January 25, 2027, and mature October 25, 2040. Holders seeking to retain notes must submit a hold notice by noon New York time October 21, 2026; otherwise notes are deemed tendered. This is a routine ABS remarketing, not a special situation.
